attributes.board_name: Delaware Board of Mental Health and Chemical Dependency Professionals

rules.accepted_credit_types: CE approved by national mental health or substance abuse organizations or local affiliates (NBCC, AAMFT, IFTA, NAADAC, Delaware Certification Board, NASW, ATCB, APA) regardless of content; other activities maintaining professional competence (interactive courses, workshops, seminars, webinars); teaching, presenting original papers or peer-reviewed writing up to 20 h
rules.new_licensee_rule: First period prorated by issue date: 0 h (Apr 1-Sep 30 even year), 10 h (Oct 1 odd-Mar 31 even), 20 h (Apr 1-Sep 30 odd), 30 h (Oct 1 even-Mar 31 odd); prorated periods need 1 h ethics and 1 h cultural inclusion.
rules.audit_note: Electronic attestation; random post-renewal audits (late renewals always audited). Keep attendance certificates at least 1 year after renewal.
rules.notes: Board of Mental Health and Chemical Dependency Professionals also licenses LCDPs and art therapists under the same CE rule. Associate licensees (LACMH/LAMFT) are not required to complete CE. Licenses renew Sep 30 of even-numbered years.
rules.rule_quote: 12.2.1 Licensees must complete at least 40 acceptable CE hours, including 3 hours of continuing education in ethics and 3 hours in cultural inclusion, equity, and diversity, during the previous licensure period in order to renew their license.
